_readme: Per-app port/start-command/health-check/ingress map, read by story-env.ps1 (R4/R5/R6:
env pointing, port ownership, health checks) and switch-story.ps1 (unmapped-app warning).
Ground truth for WHAT apps exist is the disk (switch-story.ps1's 'apps' action scans for
home-base clones) - this file only maps the ones you want story-env.ps1 to manage.
An app absent from 'apps' below still works everywhere else; story-env.ps1 just reports it
Per-app fields (all optional - add only what a given app needs):
port           int    - the port it listens on locally
start          string - shell command to launch it (run with cwd = the app's worktree)
health         string - health-check path, default '/' if omitted
ingressSvc     string - remote ingress service name (only if story-env's env-pointing
/ mint-pointing feature applies to your infra)
ingressToken   string - remote ingress path/token segment (see ingressSvc)
pythonSentinel: the package name story-env.ps1 checks for to decide an app is a Python app
